history.title: Our History
history.paragraph1: DevMinds was born from the passion to create digital solutions that truly make a difference. As recent software engineering graduates, we identified a clear opportunity: many businesses and entrepreneurs need quality technology but encounter generic or overly expensive solutions.
history.paragraph2: We decided to create DevMinds with a clear vision: to offer web development and custom software with the highest quality standards, using the most modern technologies on the market. Our focus centers on understanding each client's real needs and building solutions that not only work but scale and stand the test of time.
history.paragraph3: Today, DevMinds is more than a development company. We are a team of professionals committed to technical excellence, transparent communication, and client satisfaction. Every project we undertake is an opportunity to demonstrate that well-crafted technology can transform businesses.

Home.whatsappMensaje: Hi DevMinds, I'd like to talk about a project.

hero.titulo: builds the software your business needs.
hero.texto: Software engineering from Colombia for companies anywhere. Clear communication in English, US-friendly hours, and code that belongs to you.

escalera.titulo: We grow with you, step by step
escalera.subtitulo: Most clients start with the first step.

web.texto: Fast, search-ready sites that turn visitors into clients.

sistemas.texto: Invoicing, collections, inventory: the work you still do in spreadsheets.

apps.texto: Your service in your customers' pockets.

soporte.texto: We review it, improve it and keep it running.

conversamos.texto: Tell us about your business and what you need. The first call is free.

proponemos.texto: Scope, timeline and a fixed price in writing. You can pay in stages.

construimos.texto: You see real progress every week, not just at the end.

lanzamos.texto: We go live, show you how to use it and keep supporting you.

quienes.texto: DevMinds is a software studio based in Colombia. You talk directly to the person who designs and builds your project, no middlemen.
quienes.tecnologias: We work with Next.js, React, Flutter, PostgreSQL and whatever your project needs.

preguntas.subtitulo: What almost everyone asks before we start.

costo.pregunta: How much does it cost and how do I pay?
costo.respuesta: Every project is different. After a free first call we send a written proposal with scope, timeline and a fixed price. You can pay in stages as the project moves forward.

tiempo.respuesta: A website or landing page usually takes 1 to 2 weeks. Custom systems take 1 to 3 months depending on scope. We agree on a clear timeline before starting.

propiedad.respuesta: Yes. When the project is done you get the full source code, documentation and every access. It is yours.

google.pregunta: Will my website show up on Google?
google.respuesta: Yes. Sites are built search-ready: fast, well structured and with proper metadata. If you have a physical location, we also help you set up your Google Business Profile.

soporte.respuesta: We show you how to use what we built and offer support and maintenance plans so everything keeps working as your business grows.

alcance.pregunta: Do you work with clients outside Colombia?
alcance.respuesta: Yes. We work remotely by video call with clients anywhere. Colombia shares business hours with the US, so meetings are easy to schedule.

cierre.texto: Tell us what you need and we will reply within 24 hours, no strings attached.
